run_fused_topk: run fused_topk to compute top-k expert routing from hidden states and gating output with softmax or sigmoid scoring
create_FusedTopKRouter: create a FusedTopKRouter instance for standard fused top-k routing with configurable top-k, scoring function, and renormalization
test_vllm_topk_softmax: test vllm_topk_softmax to apply softmax normalization and select top-k experts from gating output weights
test_vllm_topk_sigmoid: test vllm_topk_sigmoid to apply sigmoid activation and select top-k experts from gating output weights
summarize_dispatch_topk_softmax_func: summarize dispatch_topk_softmax_func that returns either rocm_aiter_ops.topk_softmax or vllm_topk_softmax based on rocm availability
